official_definition: (Once per Turn: Same Name) Summon this card without paying the cost. Then, by sending one core from any of your "Izanagi" Grandwalker Nexus to this Spirit, heavy exhaust up to two opposing Spirits.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Kamiumi Unleash] or [Kamiumi Unleash: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Kamiumi Unleash]", "give [Kamiumi Unleash]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
